s: Can an AI agent manage the panel?

t: MCP is the Model Context Protocol: a way for an AI client - a chat assistant, an IDE, a bot - to call tools instead of guessing. This panel speaks it, so a client can list your customers, create one, extend a plan, read a node's status, and more.

s: How do I turn it on?
t: Open the MCP section in the panel and switch it on. Create a token with the full scope under Developer API, then point your client at POST /api/mcp with Authorization: Bearer … . No CSRF header and no cookie: a cookie is refused outright, because a browser cookie driving an agent would be a cross-si

Yes - and that is why three things are built on top. Every tool call writes an audit row, so the log shows exactly what the agent did. Destructive tools refuse to run unless the call carries the exact confirmation string the refusal names. And each token has a calls-per-minute budget you set.

Exactly what its own token could reach. An MCP token is an ordinary API token, so this is not a new door into the panel - it is a door your token already had. A token whose scope is not full cannot use MCP at all.
